IRS990.MissionDesc: THE STIMSON CENTER PROMOTES INTERNATIONAL SECURITY, SHARED PROSPERITY & JUSTICE THROUGH APPLIED RESEARCH AND INDEPENDENT ANALYSIS, DEEP ENGAGEMENT, AND POLICY INNOVATION.
IRS990.Desc: GRAND STRATEGY IN PIVOTAL PLACES: FOCUSES ON THE KEY PLAYERS IN GLOBAL PEACE, SECURITY, AND GREAT POWER COMPETITION. PROGRAMMATIC WORK EXAMINES HOW POLITICAL, ECONOMIC, AND SECURITY DYNAMICS IN AREAS LIKE THE INDO-PACIFIC, LATIN AMERICA, THE MIDDLE EAST, AND NORTH AFRICA SHAPE INTERNATIONAL STABILITY. THE WORK AIMS TO REDUCE CONFLICT, STRENGTHEN COOPERATION, AND SUPPORT SECURITY IN THESE STRATEGICALLY IMPORTANT REGIONS THROUGH NEW DIALOGUE AND POLICY SOLUTIONS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: PROMOTING SECURITY AND PROSPERITY: EXAMINES HOW CONVENTIONAL AND EMERGING TECHNOLOGIES, ECONOMIC STATECRAFT, AND SHIFTING GLOBAL POWER DYNAMICS SHAPE INTERNATIONAL SECURITY AND FOREIGN POLICY. PROGRAMMATIC WORK SPANS CRITICAL ISSUES LIKE EXPORT CONTROLS, THE INTERNATIONAL ARMS TRADE, SUPPLY CHAIN SECURITY, DIGITAL GOVERNANCE, AND THE GEOPOLITICAL IMPLICATIONS OF ADVANCED TECHNOLOGIESINCLUDING AI AND SEMICONDUCTORSALONGSIDE DETERRENCE, ARMS CONTROL, NON-PROLIFERATION, NUCLEAR RISK REDUCTION, AND THE EVOLVING ROLE OF ALLIANCES AND PARTNERSHIPS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: PROTECTING PEOPLE: EXPLORES HOW GOVERNANCE, HUMAN RIGHTS, AND INCLUSIVE INSTITUTIONS CAN UNDERPIN PEACE AND STABILITY. PROGRAMMATIC WORK EXAMINES CHALLENGES SUCH AS CONFLICT, PEACEKEEPING, AND THE PROTECTION OF CIVILIANS IN CRISIS SETTINGS, AS WELL AS THE MULTILATERAL AND REGIONAL INSTITUTIONS AND MECHANISMS DEVELOPED TO ADDRESS THOSE CHALLENGES. THROUGH RESEARCH AND ENGAGEMENT, THE PROGRAMMATIC WORK PROMOTES GOVERNANCE AND POLICIES THAT STRENGTHEN HUMAN SECURITY AT THE LOCAL, NATIONAL, AND INTERNATIONAL LEVELS.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: PRESERVING THE PLANET: EXPLORES THE LINKS BETWEEN NATURAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT, ENVIRONMENTAL RISK, AND GLOBAL STABILITY. PROGRAMMATIC WORK FOCUSES ON HOW WATER, ENERGY, AND OTHER RESOURCE CHALLENGES EXACERBATE SECURITY CONCERNS, PARTICULARLY IN FRAGILE AND CONFLICT-PRONE REGIONS. THROUGH RESEARCH, DIALOGUE, AND POLICY ENGAGEMENT, THE PROGRAMMATIC WORK BUILDS PRACTICAL SOLUTIONS TO INCREASE RESILIENCE, REDUCE RISKS, AND SUPPORT A MORE SECURE FUTURE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CENTER HAS A COLLECTION OF ARTWORK PRINCIPALLY COMPRISED OF PAINTINGS. THE ARTWORK IS UTILIZED BY THE CENTER FOR OFFICE DECORATION, SERVING TO ENHANCE ITS FACILITIES FOR ITS PERSONNEL AND VISITORS.

STIMSON MONITORS FUNDS BY USING AN APPROVAL PROCESS FOR INVOICES AND MATCHING PAYMENTS TO THE CONTRACT, MONITORING DELIVERABLES AND DEADLINES TO ENSURE FUNDS ARE BEING PROCESSED AFTER DELIVERABLES HAVE BEEN MET AND REGULAR COMMUNICATIONS WITH GRANTEES TO ENSURE COMPLIANCE AND DISCUSS CHALLENGES AND SUCCESSES.

STIMSON CENTER MONITORS THE GRANTS THROUGH THE FULL LIFE-CYCLE, PRE-AWARD, AWARD, AND POST-AWARD. STIMSON COLLECTS APPROPRIATE INFORMATION IN THE PRE-AWARD STAGE AND MAKES SURE THE GRANTEE ALIGNS WITH STIMSON'S NEEDS AND GOALS AND THAT THEY HAVE THE SYSTEMS IN PLACE TO OPERATE THE GRANT AND PROVIDE THE REQUIRED REPORTING. DURING THE AWARD PHASE, STIMSON DETAILS OUT THE AWARD REQUIREMENTS IN A FORMAL LETTER OF AGREEMENT OR MOU. ONCE SIGNED, STIMSON'S PROGRAM STAFF MONITORS THE COMPLETION OF DELIVERABLES WHILE FINANCE STAFF MONITORS THE SPENDING, FINANCIAL REPORTS, AND OTHER ASPECTS REQUIRED. DURING THE POST-AWARD PHASE, STIMSON ENSURES AND VERIFIES ALL OBLIGATIONS WERE MET. THERE IS A REVIEW OF THE FINAL REPORTING TO ENSURE ALL ITEMS ARE CLOSED FOR THE GRANT.
HEALTH CLUB PREMIUMS AS PART OF STIMSON'S WELLNESS BENEFIT PROVIDED TO ALL EMPLOYEES. MAXIMUM OF $56 A MONTH.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: UPON RECEIPT OF THE DRAFT FORM 990, THE VICE PRESIDENT FOR FINANCE AND OPERATIONS AND THE ACCOUNTING DIRECTOR PERFORM A COMPREHENSIVE REVIEW TO CONFIRM THE ACCURACY, COMPLETENESS, AND CONSISTENCY OF THE REPORTED INFORMATION. ALL COMMENTS, CORRECTIONS, OR UPDATES RESULTING FROM THIS INTERNAL REVIEW ARE COMMUNICATED TO THE ORGANIZATION'S EXTERNAL ACCOUNTANTS TO ENSURE THAT THE FINAL FILING ACCURATELY REFLECTS THE ORGANIZATION'S FINANCIAL AND OPERATIONAL DATA. THE FINAL 990 IS DISTRIBUTED TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION'S POLICY AND PRACTICES FOR MONITORING PROPOSED AND/OR PERCEIVED CONFLICTS OF INTEREST ARE DETAILED IN THE ORGANIZATION'S CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY WHICH IS DISTRIBUTED TO ALL STAFF MEMBERS UPON HIRE AND NEW BOARD MEMBERS UPON APPOINTMENT. ALL STAFF AND THE BOARD ARE COVERED UNDER THIS POLICY AND POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST ARE REVIEWED BY THE PRESIDENT AND CEO, OR, IF IT IS IN RELATION TO THE PRESIDENT AND CEO, REVIEWED BY AN APPROPRIATE MEMBER OF THE BOARD EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE. IN THE EVENT OF A CONFLICT, THE PRESIDENT AND CEO WILL IMPLEMENT STEPS NECESSARY TO ADDRESS AND RESOLVE THE CONFLICT. THE EMPLOYEE INVOLVED IN THE CONFLICT SITUATION MUST WORK COOPERATIVELY WITH THE CENTER TO ACHIEVE A RESOLUTION OF THE CONFLICT ISSUES IN THE BEST INTERESTS OF THE CENTER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EACH KEY EMPLOYEE'S IMMEDIATE SUPERVISOR REVIEWS THEIR PERFORMANCE. PAY ADJUSTMENTS TYPICALLY INCLUDE A VARIABLE MERIT INCREASE. THE PERCENTAGE INCREASE IS DETERMINED BY THE ORGANIZATION'S FINANCIAL POSITION AND INDUSTRY TRENDS. THE VICE PRESIDENT OF FINANCE AND OPERATIONS REVIEWS THESE FACTORS - ALONG WITH INTERNAL EQUITY AND MARKET COMPETITIVENESS - AND MAKES RECOMMENDATIONS TO THE PRESIDENT & CEO. THE PRESIDENT & CEO APPROVES ALL SALARY ADJUSTMENTS. THE COMPENSATION OF THE PRESIDENT & CEO IS SET BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND DOCUMENTED ANNUALLY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE GOVERNING DOCUMENTS AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE NOT MADE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC. THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS AVAILABLE ON THE ORGANIZATION'S WEBSITE.
